text: わしゃ　もう　いうことは　ない！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb put right before a thing tells you what kind of thing it is; こと here is a real 'thing'. いうこと = 'things to say'.

patterns.name: もう〜ない
patterns.span: もう　いうことは　ない
patterns.explanation: もう together with 'not' means 'no longer, no more'. もう　いうことは　ない = 'there is nothing more to say'.
